notes: Annual averages of daily noon buying rates in New York (Federal Reserve G.5A), cited from the dated January 5, 2026 release, which carries 2022-2025 columns; the 'current' URL rolls over each January. Every non-USD currency in research/records/*.json is in G.5A, so the IRS yearly average rates were not needed. Year rule: the calendar year that covers most of the fiscal year; fiscal years ending January-June map to the prior calendar year (e.g. March 2025 year-ends use 2024; Biocon's FY24 ending March 31, 2024 uses 2023), and December year-ends use the same year. The EUR row is published as USD per euro (asterisk), so its perUSD is the inverse (1 ÷ stated, 6 decimals) and the published figure is kept in 'stated'. All other rows are published as currency units per USD and perUSD is the figure as printed. CNY is G.5A's 'CHINA, P.R. YUAN' (renminbi). To convert: USD = local amount ÷ perUSD.
